chunks: With this chain of transmission, from al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd, from al-Qāsim, from ʿAlī, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about a dog touching the garment. He said: "Sprinkle water on it, and if it was wet, then wash it."

key_terms.الثَّوْبَ: garment or clothing affected by the contact
key_terms.الْكَلْبِ: dog; the source of contact discussed in the ruling
key_terms.اِنْضِحْهُ: sprinkle water on it; the instructed act for this case
key_terms.رَطْبًا: wet or moist; the condition that changes the ruling
key_terms.فَاغْسِلْهُ: then wash it; the required purification when wet contact occurs

ai.seo_question: What should be done if a dog touches a garment in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding a garment that comes into contact with a dog. It distinguishes between dry contact, for which sprinkling is instructed, and wet contact, for which washing is required, reflecting rulings of ritual purity.
